title: SecureLLMBench | Benchmark evidence
description: A single-page view of persisted engineering benchmark summaries. No unsupported behavioral-drift value is plotted.

options.content:
# SecureLLMBench benchmark evidence
The marked line below shows saved **engineering detector summaries** for repository-example runs using detector formula v1. Each marker is one completed run. Other formula versions are excluded. These are not calibrated model-safety scores. Different runs need not be comparable as a controlled time series.

**Before attack → after attack drift:** unavailable. The database does not yet contain matched, validated behavioral measurements for both conditions; no drift value is inferred or plotted.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_runs FROM scientific_records WHERE family = 'model_score' AND status = 'computed' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.dataset_kind') = 'repository_example' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.scientifically_validated') = 0 AND json_extract(payload, '$.formula_version') = 'engineering-detector-score-v1'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_runs FROM scientific_records WHERE family = 'model_score' AND status = 'computed' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.dataset_kind') = 'repository_example' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.scientifically_validated') = 0 AND json_extract(payload, '$.formula_version') = 'engineering-detector-score-v1'

options.content:
## Unavailable
No validated matched before/after attack measurements are persisted.

## Engineering only
Repository-example detector signals; no safety ranking or model recommendation.

panels.title: Benchmark detector summary by completed run
panels.description: Chronological run number is the x-axis. Each point is one persisted engineering detector summary; completion timestamps and run IDs are listed below.

targets.queryText: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id) AS run_number, ROUND(CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.model_score') AS REAL) * 100, 2) AS detector_summary_pct FROM scientific_records WHERE family = 'model_score' AND status = 'computed' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.dataset_kind') = 'repository_example' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.scientifically_validated') = 0 AND json_extract(payload, '$.formula_version') = 'engineering-detector-score-v1' AND json_extract(payload, '$.model_score') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at, id
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id) AS run_number, ROUND(CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.model_score') AS REAL) * 100, 2) AS detector_summary_pct FROM scientific_records WHERE family = 'model_score' AND status = 'computed' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.dataset_kind') = 'repository_example' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.scientifically_validated') = 0 AND json_extract(payload, '$.formula_version') = 'engineering-detector-score-v1' AND json_extract(payload, '$.model_score') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at, id

panels.title: Run provenance and exact summary values

targets.queryText: SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 16) AS completed_utc, json_extract(payload, '$.model_name') AS model, json_extract(payload, '$.run_id') AS run_id, printf('%d/%d', json_extract(payload, '$.completed_evaluations'), json_extract(payload, '$.total_evaluations')) AS cases, ROUND(CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.model_score') AS REAL) * 100, 2) AS detector_summary_pct FROM scientific_records WHERE family = 'model_score' AND status = 'computed' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.dataset_kind') = 'repository_example' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.scientifically_validated') = 0 AND json_extract(payload, '$.formula_version') = 'engineering-detector-score-v1' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 16) AS completed_utc, json_extract(payload, '$.model_name') AS model, json_extract(payload, '$.run_id') AS run_id, printf('%d/%d', json_extract(payload, '$.completed_evaluations'), json_extract(payload, '$.total_evaluations')) AS cases, ROUND(CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.model_score') AS REAL) * 100, 2) AS detector_summary_pct FROM scientific_records WHERE family = 'model_score' AND status = 'computed' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.dataset_kind') = 'repository_example' AND json_extract(provenance, '$.scientifically_validated') = 0 AND json_extract(payload, '$.formula_version') = 'engineering-detector-score-v1' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

options.content:
### Baseline → attack → recovery
The exploratory Phase 4 observations include condition labels, but their responses have no validated common behavioral state. Plotting a numerical path between conditions would invent a drift measurement. Once matched baseline/attack records and a validated measurement are persisted, this panel can plot the paired change with its source IDs and uncertainty.
